summary: Invalidates stale TEXT history fetches when navigation changes. A realtime refresh that completes after leaving TEXT no longer keeps the conversation loading indicator stuck or overwrites state for a different selection.

checks.name: TEXT refresh then navigate to VOICE regression
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/app_state_test.dart --plain-name 'text refresh cannot leave message loading stuck after channel switch'
checks.observation: The test initially failed because loadingMessages remained true after a gated TEXT refresh completed following navigation to VOICE. A generation gate and loading-state reset on selection change make the final state idle without applying the stale page.

limitations: No Android device or ADB was available or required for these state-level checks.
Live WebSocket delivery, server-backed read-cursor behavior and desktop runtime acceptance were not exercised.
remaining: Verify realtime/read-cursor behavior against the live server and continue platform runtime acceptance when devices are available.
